question: What do rheumatoid arthritis, Sjögren's syndrome and systemic lupus erythematosus have in common ?:

options.opa: They are diseases due to type I (immediate) hypersensitivity.
options.opb: They are diseases due to type IV hypersensitivity (delayed)

analysis: Rheumatoid arthritis, Sjögren's syndrome, and systemic lupus erythematosus are all systemic autoimmune diseases that can affect multiple organs and systems in the body.
